definition-changed.answer: The rule uses 'procedure division' (the division), never the defined term 'procedure'; §2002:4 (entry 4.150) 'One or more successive paragraphs or sections in the procedure division' vs §2023:3.145 does not touch what the division is. Scope and evidence unchanged.

definition-dropped.answer: §2002:4 (entry 4.163) defines report as the printed output described in the report section; 2023 drops the entry and the term rests on the RD entry and REPORT clause (§2023:13.18.46.1). In both editions a report is exactly what one RD describes, so the rule governs the same report groups and RDs. 'the report description' is the RD entry in both.
